items.title: Return completed claim questionnaire and wildlife damage certificate
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: The letter fixes the start of the period itself as 'dem Datum dieses Schreibens' = 21.11.2026 (Saturday), not the day of delivery. Under §187(1) BGB the day of the triggering event is not counted, so counting starts 22.11.2026 (Sunday). The letter defines 'Werktage' as Monday–Saturday excluding statutory public holidays, so Sundays (and any NRW holidays) are skipped when counting the 13 Werktage. Counting forward: 23.11 Mon(1), 24.11 Tue(2), 25.11 Wed(3), 26.11 Thu(4), 27.11 Fri(5), 28.11 Sat(6), [29.11 Sun skipped], 30.11 Mon(7), 01.12 Tue(8), 02.12 Wed(9), 03.12 Thu(10), 04.12 Fri(11), 05.12 Sat(12), [06.12 Sun skipped], 07.12 Mon(13). There are no NRW public holidays between 21.11.2026 and 07.12.2026, so the 13th Werktag, Monday 07.12.2026, is the last day the completed form must be returned.
